entries.0a1325cf6a080e6c: In the Consulting Business, it provides services such as performance-fee cost reduction support, for which it receives fees according to results, and in the Fund Business it invests in unlisted companies and provides hands-on management support.
entries.1c89219a15b4d3fe: In the Consulting Business, it provides performance-fee cost management and success-fee management consulting, which includes an 'investment phase' before a paid contract is signed. In the Fund Business, it structures and manages funds and provides hands-on management support to investee companies.
entries.3393908fa9c631f7: Consulting customers include major listed companies, private equity funds and local governments, among others. In the Fund Business, it invests in small and mid-sized companies and supports their management.
entries.34b148d0080334b9: Net sales for the fiscal year ended October 2025 were ¥12,302 million, up 158.7% from the previous year. Revenue was ¥8,180 million from the Fund Business and ¥4,122 million from the Consulting Business, and the main factor behind the large increase in Fund Business revenue was the sale of shares held by Dolphin No. 1 Investment Limited Liability Partnership.
entries.35c6d4595bc914f5: For performance-fee consulting, it states that it uses a structure in which no fee arises unless results are achieved, and by providing standardized pattern-order services for high-demand services, it realizes services that do not depend on the experience or skill of individual consultants. It also cites as a feature that it uses data on actual corporate cost prices by industry and by cost category in its consulting, measuring results for each project and continuing to improve.
entries.38fdb10ce89e3a64: In fixed-fee consulting, it adopts a success-fee model that sets an “investment phase” before paid contracts are signed. Across a wide range of areas, mainly growth strategy, digital, talent and organization, and operations, it provides hands-on support that accompanies clients not only to the delivery of reports but until results are achieved on site.
entries.3fff3f3df15c926d: This is consulting undertaken by the consolidated subsidiary Narejirīn Co., Ltd.
entries.41d2364db74f589d: Description in [Business Overview] of hands-on support through fund staff taking up director positions at investee companies, and of collaboration with the Consulting Business
entries.4236ad6bc9dbb60d: Consulting fees (fixed fees, success fees, performance fees)
entries.5b1b0d25a96540af: A company that provides consulting, including on a performance-based fee basis, to large companies and also operates a fund that invests in small and medium-sized companies.
entries.665acbd81e10328d: This is consulting undertaken by the consolidated subsidiary Narejirīn Co., Ltd. It supports local governments in formulating and surveying basic environmental plans and in building and operating environmental management systems, and provides private companies with a one-stop service covering decarbonization target setting, planning, implementation support and information disclosure.
entries.694c44301fc49a7d: This service supports cost reduction of indirect materials, such as consumables, communication, cleaning, facility security and electricity costs, on a performance-fee basis. Once the client confirms the cost savings achieved, it receives a fixed percentage of those savings as its fee. It has also launched Pro-Sign, a contract management SaaS for multi-store companies, and links it with its consulting services.
entries.6d10aeb7a9283481: Large companies, such as major listed companies
entries.852b905f10c2e1ef: This service supports cost reduction of indirect materials, such as consumables, communication, cleaning, facility security and electricity costs, on a performance-fee basis.
entries.86a8aef22fe88f82: This business forms and manages funds, mainly for investment in unlisted companies. As GP, it handles everything from forming and selecting deals to post-investment management support and achieving Exit, earns capital gains and carried interest, and also invests its own funds in the funds as an LP investor. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥8,180 million, an increase of 427.7% from the previous year. This was because shares held by Dolphin No. 1 Investment Limited Partnership were sold and dividends were received. Management is mainly carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Bullpass Capital Co., Ltd.
entries.9283428f5900071d: In fixed-fee consulting, it adopts a success-fee model that sets an “investment phase” before paid contracts are signed.
entries.96bca207e6c4a08c: Net profit attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥205 million, down 35.6% from the previous year. This is because most of the voting rights in Dolphin No. 1 Investment Limited Liability Partnership are held by external investors, and much of the Fund Business's income is therefore not attributable to owners of the parent.
entries.9d94ca6fb9496398: As its medium-term management policy, it sets out expanding its consulting services business. It states that it will establish a success-fee model that adds an 'investment phase' before a paid contract to fixed-fee services, expand its scale, and work on improving consulting quality, recruiting and developing talented people, and strengthening sales capabilities with large companies. In the Fund Business, it states that it will continue hands-on support for investee companies to improve fund performance.

entries.c02e6335934353ca: A business that forms and manages funds, mainly for the purpose of investing in unlisted companies.
entries.cbc6a339e0410282: This business provides management consulting to clients including large listed companies, private equity funds and local governments.
entries.d993df0e261ef213: A group consisting of Prored Partners CO.,LTD. and 14 consolidated subsidiaries, with its head office in Akasaka, Minato-ku, Tokyo. The number of employees for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was 329.
entries.de681cac8cad70e6: This business provides management consulting to clients including large listed companies, private equity funds and local governments. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥4,122 million, an increase of 28.6% from the previous fiscal year. Its main pillars are the expansion of a success-fee model that sets an “investment phase” before paid contracts are signed, which sits alongside fixed-fee services, and services that support indirect-material cost reduction on a performance-fee basis.
entries.e472af513d2b3760: The management support expertise developed in the Consulting Business is also used to support investee companies in the Fund Business. Through hands-on support in which fund staff take up director positions at investee companies, and through collaboration between consulting services and funds, the structure aims for both enhancing the value of investee companies and achieving fund results.
